title: Monsoon Ledger entry
description: One entry in data/entries/. The file name must be <id>.yml.

id.description: Must equal the file name without .yml. Format: YYYY-MM-DD-slug.

date.description: The date of the event or statement the entry records.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code. Only Indonesia for now.

instrument.description: Must match an id in data/instruments.yml.

quote.description: Optional. One short quote in the original language, with an English line. The original must be under 15 words, and each source can be quoted at most once across all entries.

source_url.description: Must be one of this entry's source urls.

recipient.description: Who receives incident reports: a named body that exists and works, a named body not yet set up, no body named, or unclear.

cross_border.description: Does it address AI systems or incidents that cross borders, such as systems built abroad that act on systems at home?

frontier_scope.description: Does it address frontier AI: the most capable models, or the risks of their control and alignment?

safety_lens.description: The safety lens. yes: a cited source states it. no: a cited source states the opposite, or the full text has been read and it is absent (absence in a press summary is not no). unclear: the default. recipient, cross_border and frontier_scope were added in lens v2 and are optional, with a validator warning when missing.

safety_note_en.description: Optional note shown under the Safety lens panel.

lens_basis_en.description: Required when any lens value is not unclear. One or two sentences saying which cited source supports each coded value.

lens_basis_id.description: Bahasa Indonesia version of lens_basis_en. Required with it.

lens_checked.description: The day the lens values were last checked against the sources.

last_checked.description: The last date the sources were re-verified.

perbandingan_eu_id.description: Optional Bahasa Indonesia version of eu_comparison.

my_take.description: English, first person. Written by the author only. Optional: an entry without it shows no "My take" section, and the validator warns.

pendapat_id.description: Optional Bahasa Indonesia version of my_take.

archive_url.description: A preserved copy of url, written by npm run archive.

archived_at.description: The day that copy was made.
